**Very disappointing experience**

I booked my cat to stay here for two nights and told them that he needs daily medication. I was charged extra in advance for this service which was fine. But when I arrived, I was told they did not know he needed medication.. When I asked them to recheck our email conversation, they then raised concerns that I didn't specify what illness the medication was for. They did not ask for this information beforehand, so I didn't understand why this was only raised once I arrived.

I was then assured everything would be fine, but just a couple of hours after I left, they called to complain that my cat was extremely nervous and scared. There was nothing I could do at this point so this only stressed me out. When I called for an update the following day, the person I spoke to was very rude and repeatedly told me how difficult my cat had made the whole medicating process for them. This is a **veterinary practice with qualified professionals**, so I found their attitude towards a frightened animal particularly discomforting. My cat is an exclusively indoors cat. He is not feral or aggressive. Just scared of being in a new environment.

When I collected him two days later, it was clear he had suffered a seizure during his time there. His neck was wet and matted from foaming at the mouth, which is consistent with previous seizures. The receptionist suggested the wetness could have been caused by his medication, but he only receives 1ml of medicine so there was no reason to believe this was the cause. He had not seizured since 2024, so the fact that this happened during his stay here was extremely concerning.

I requested a follow-up call or email to discuss exactly what had happened during his stay, particularly as the main vet was not on site when I collected him. I never heard back from them.

Overall, this was a very upsetting experience for both me and my cat. He was clearly traumatised when I collected him. I paid for a professional veterinary cattery service, including an additional fee for his medication, and expected his medical and emotional needs to be properly understood and managed. I would never use their services again, and I would not recommend other pet owners to go there.

I have been a customer at Medivet Hornsey for five years and have previously left positive reviews. Unfortunately, my recent experience — and the way my formal complaint has been handled — has completely destroyed my trust in this practice.

My cat is on a paid care plan that includes flea treatment. After being advised to switch from spot-on treatment to tablets due to an adverse reaction, the practice implicitly accused me of “abusing the system” because of some administrative error which told them that,despite paying monthly for the plan, I have "used up my allowance". As a result, I have not been able to receive the flea medication my cat requires and which I have consistently paid for monthly since 2023.

More concerning is what followed. I submitted a formal written complaint and was told I would receive a response within 15 working days. That deadline passed. I followed up. Head Office intervened. I set a further 5 working day deadline. That too has passed with no substantive response.

In addition, services included in the care plan (such as annual urine screening) have not been offered for years, despite being paid for.

The original issue was serious enough. The complete failure to engage with a formal complaint for over a month is worse. The lack of accountability and basic complaint handling standards is deeply disappointing.

I would strongly urge anyone considering a care plan here to think carefully.

I had an extremely disappointing and upsetting experience with Medivet.
I brought my cat in for a scan after he had been vomiting, and was originally quoted £470. However, I was later charged an additional £80 for "hospitalisation" — despite the fact that my cat was never hospitalised. I personally brought him in, waited in my car, and was called in 15 minutes later when the scan was done. No one explained this charge beforehand. When I questioned it, they told me the cost was for a nurse holding the cat during the scan — excuse me? Isn’t that part of what I’m already paying for in the scan? That’s like booking a flight and being charged extra for the pilot to fly it.
Then came the results — a shockingly vague and negative explanation, with worst-case scenarios like tumors and FIP being thrown at me. There was no clear breakdown, no time to process or ask questions, and I was suddenly being pushed to approve a £900 kidney biopsy on the spot. It felt like scare tactics. I was emotionally distressed and unprepared to pay that kind of money — especially when they refused to deal directly with my pet insurance, forcing me to pay upfront.
To add to the frustration, I had already paid £200 for what they called a "full course" of blood tests, only to be told later that it didn’t include FIP testing — even though that was one of the main diagnoses they suspected! So what exactly did I pay £200 for?
The staff were rude, dismissive, and more focused on pushing expensive procedures than on actually helping my cat. It no longer feels like they’re in this for the love of animals — it feels like it’s all about money. I’m heartbroken and angry, and will do everything I can to warn others.
Please, think twice before trusting your pets to this clinic. I wouldn’t wish this experience on anyone

When I phoned & questioned this, they put me on hold & stated there had been a ‘price increase’ (quite a leap in 6 weeks) and were unable to honour my previous quote.
In addition, I had been sent an email promotion for free health check & nail clip. Due to my cat’s initial diagnosis, the vet advised we postpone the nail clip to the follow-up appt. So not only had the follow up blood test increased by £56.08 without warning but they added the full charge for the ‘free’  nail clip, even through the vet wrote it would be complimentary on the notes & I reminded them when I booked the follow-up appt. No manager, when requested was availble to discuss this. Very suspicious, dubious & unhelpful practice.
